Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: Factmend homepage hero and cinematic intro animation keyframe.
Target dimensions: 1440 x 1024, landscape desktop website screenshot, no browser chrome. One design only, not a collage or multiple options.
Existing brand is approved: Sunlit Archive. References attached: image 1 is current homepage for exact brand and copy; image 2 is approved earlier art direction for warm tactile mood only, NOT its old logo, preview labels, or isolated glass-object hero; image 3 is the definitive existing logo lockup, preserve it accurately. Palette: paper #F7F4EC, deep olive #1F2617, sage #DDE3D2, peach #F7C9A3, amber #F49A23, muted olive #59634B. Instrument Serif regular and italic for elegant editorial headlines, Inter for nav and UI. No third font.
At 1440 width use a coherent 12-column grid, 80px outer margins, 24px gutters, readable natural wrapping, 24px title/body gaps, 48px control height, refined 8px control radii, understated contact shadows with one consistent daylight direction. Long copy left aligned, comfortable line length. Detail work should feel like a commissioned premium SaaS brand.
Use existing accurate logo top left. Navbar links Products, Platform, Solutions, Resources, Pricing; Sign in and amber Let's talk button right. Avoid unnecessary nav items.
Exact headline: 'Memory changes. Keep the whole story.' Exact body: 'Know what your assistant remembers, where it came from, and where it goes next.' Exact primary button: 'Map your memory paths' with simple arrow; secondary text link 'Explore the workspace'.
Visual tells a SINGLE memory example: source conversation, old value 'Email invoices', current correction 'Portal only', purpose 'Support', controlled delivery to memory store and index, preserved history and evidence. Represent permission and retained history geometrically. These are illustrative records, no fake metrics, no all-erased claim.
Keep just a few readable useful labels, no decorative annotations or illegible fake dashboard text. Do not display preview, demo, concept, synthetic data, option numbers, direction names, motion stage labels, or production notes.
No floating chrome blobs, particle networks, generic blue/purple glow, gratuitous badges, feature-card inventories, glassmorphism, nested cards, random laptop mockups, or cropped text. Source references are moodboard grounding; improve the hero, do not clone their old layout. This should feel like a whole website introduction and the beginning of a scroll story, not a poster or a single-feature dashboard.
Direction name for internal art direction only: Sunlit Record Landscape. Do NOT print this name in the design.
Layout: airy asymmetrical hero. Headline at upper left in 96px serif, body and CTA just below. Main cinematic scene occupies the lower half and right side, woven into the background with no huge rounded panel framing it. A shallow oblique overhead camera sees a complete physical memory landscape: source sheet at lower left, three offset olive/paper/amber record layers at center right, two destination surfaces farther right, refined paths inscribed on the paper surface connecting them. A sage perimeter crisply separates allowed routes. Large legible correction 'Portal only' on foremost record, old 'Email invoices' on recessed history leaf. The scene should feel like precisely crafted paper and archival sheets lit by warm late-afternoon sunlight, with subtle shadow patterns, not monumental slabs or glass towers. Composition has visual depth and meaningful connections, but copy sits on clean paper. Navigation and headline align to 80px margin. Bottom edge suggests next peach chapter with a thin divider and a restrained serif phrase 'One fact. Every place it travels.' This image represents the final composed frame of an eight-second animation, ready to unfold on scroll. No stage annotations.

Layout: a markedly different calm editorial composition with balanced 5-column text on the left and 7-column visual on the right. This is a sophisticated art-directed website viewport, full hero plus a restrained start of next scroll chapter.

Layout: cinematic full-width composition with headline centered high beneath quiet navigation, two-line 88px editorial serif treatment, concise body centered to a maximum 620px and amber CTA under it. 'Email invoices' is retained behind 'Portal only' in a small elegant page turn at the center, with 'Support' purpose visible. At right the ribbon separates into 'Memory store' and 'Index', with a slim evidence strip beneath showing the source/history relationship. Three leaf silhouette subtly echoes exact existing brand mark without inventing a new logo. Use airy off-white background upper half, a subtle peach light field below, and one deep olive band entering at the very bottom with a cropped but readable chapter sentence 'Keep the source. Follow the change.' Dark band uses light text. The story is connected and cinematic, with generous whitespace and real readable content. The graphic should naturally unfold vertically as the visitor scrolls. Do not add trees, pens, cups, decorative cursive scribbles, random badges, or a separate floating sculpture.
